collection.title: Mercedes-Benz E Class Cabriolet 2010 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Mercedes-Benz E Class Convertible 2010 - 2016 (207) will fit, this model requires a 24" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
